readme: # Lona ![alt logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lufte/lona/master/icon_128.png) A snake-like html5 game. https://lufte.github.io/lona [](https://f-droid.org/packages/io.github.lufte.lona/) ## History Read Lona's history on my blog: https://lufte.net/en/post/lona-chronicles/ ## Releases Note to myself: to release new versions to F-Droid, you need to copy source and asset files from the repository root to `/android-app/app/src/main/assets/www/`. Then tag the release commit with `vX.Y.Z` and F-Droid will pick it up automatically.
